sentence_stem: If only I had studied harder,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I could have passed the exam.
I would have passed the test.

options.text: I want to study more tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This talks about a future plan, but the stem expresses a regret about the past, which needs a past perfect form.

options.text: I am happy with my results now.
options.why_wrong: This describes a present feeling and does not express regret or a wish about the past.

I will study again next week.
options.why_wrong: This refers to the future, but 'if only' with the past perfect expresses a regret about what did not happen.

explanation: After 'if only' with a past perfect clause, the main clause uses 'would have' plus a past participle to express a regret about an unreal past situation.
